newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiki Aluminium, Kanematsu to form China metal firm.
newsitem.headline: Daiki Aluminium, Kanematsu to form China metal firm.

text.p: Daiki Aluminium Industry Co Ltd said on Friday that it and Kanematsu Corp would set up a metals joint venture in China.
The new firm, capitalised at 145 million yen, would be 51 percent owned by Daiki Aluminium, 19 percent by Kanematsu and the rest by local Chinese firms, Daiki said in a statement.
The firm was expected to produce 350 tonnes of ground metal for aluminum alloy per month, it said.
The establishment of the venture was aimed at taking advantage of growing demand for the metal product in China, the company said
